subject: REWRITE statement
notes: "If record-name-1 is specified, identifier-1 or literal-1 shall be valid as a sending operand in a MOVE statement specifying record-name-1 as the receiving operand." Both REWRITE arms bind the FROM phrase through MoveBinder.BindFromPhrase(FromPhraseRules.Rewrite, record, ...), which builds the implicit MOVE at bind time and runs the MOVE validity screens against record-name-1. Probe pi.cob (01 R1 PIC 9(5), `REWRITE R1 FROM WA` with WA PIC A(5)) -> error COBOL0819 citing 14.9.35.3 SR6 / Table 16; pk.cob `REWRITE R1 FROM FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF("ab")` into an alphanumeric X(8) record -> COBOL0819 (national to alphanumeric invalid). pb348_from_into_move_rules pins the positive equivalence. No REWRITE-specific negative fixture (the pb348 invalid-move-sender negatives are RELEASE/WRITE), so test-ref empty. cite.py --check 14.9.35.3 SR6 -> OK.
